create_TimmMixup: create a TimmMixup instance wrapping timm.data.Mixup with configurable mixup mode and label smoothing
call_TimmMixup_elem: call TimmMixup with element-wise mode to mix input tensors and produce mixed targets
call_TimmMixup_batch: call TimmMixup with batch mode to mix entire batches and return mixed inputs and targets
call_TimmMixup_pair: call TimmMixup with pair mode on even-sized batches to mix paired samples and produce mixed targets
review_TimmMixup: review the TimmMixup class that wraps timm.data.Mixup to remove the even batch size assert for elem and batch modes
